name: gripper
title: Gripper: palm and two fingers on leaves
orientation: Flat on the bed, the leaves printed upright in their layers: every wall of the leaves is a whole layer stack, no overhang, the same outline the whole way up
description: Bolts into the forearm's yoke where the pen holder bolts. Two fingers on long leaves, closed by a double-arm horn turning in the leaves' own plane: no lift, no twist. Drawn at rest, open, the leaves straight.

part.rule: 0 the whole print, 1 the palm, 2 the upper finger, 3 the lower: the closing check moves the fingers apart from the palm

width.rule: The print's thickness, and the width of the leaves: the yoke's slot and stiff against the payload's weight across the leaves

half.rule: Half of it, where the horn turns and the load sits

block_x.rule: Half the block in the yoke, along the arm

bolt_x.rule: Half the yoke's two M3 screws' spacing, as the pen holder's

xs.rule: From the bolts to the servo's shaft: the leaves' length and the servo's body set it

leaf_l.rule: A leaf's length: long, so the servo spends little of its torque bending it and the strain stays small
leaf_l.label: Leaf

leaf_t.rule: A leaf's thickness: two and a bit lines

taper.rule: Thicker toward both ends, the strain spread along it

fillet.rule: A round where each leaf meets a block: no square corner to yield at

into.rule: How far a leaf runs into the block at each end

y_in.rule: A finger's inner face at rest: the stem's side, its full travel and a gap

y_flat.rule: The flat the horn presses, the finger cut back to here so the tip reaches it from the outside

up_end.rule: The upper leaf ends just before the horn's contact

low_end.rule: The lower leaf ends just before its contact: the two arms of a horn press on opposite sides of its axis

up_root.rule: Where the upper leaf grows from

low_root.rule: Where the lower leaf grows from

arm_y.rule: Where the root arms join the palm, off the middle: clear of the forearm's bar, which runs on behind the yoke

root.rule: The root arms' depth along the arm

overlap.rule: A leaf's tip into the finger's back

flat_a.rule: The flat, starting out from the axis along the arm: where the tip touches at rest

flat_b.rule: The flat's far end: where the tip gets to at full close, with a little over

jaw_x0.rule: The jaws begin, past the end of the stem and the servo's front

jaw_at.rule: Halfway along the jaws: the payload's point and the tool's anchor

stem_x1.rule: The stem ends past the servo's front screw

stem_y.rule: Half the stem round the servo's body: 6.1 and a 2 mm wall

stem_y0.rule: Half the stem behind the servo

face.rule: The servo's mounting tabs: its case and boss reach down 13.3 mm to the horn

horn_z.rule: The horn's plane: the middle of the leaves' width, so a push on the finger doesn't twist it

horn_top.rule: The side of the horn toward the servo

case_z.rule: Where the servo's case ends, coming down

pocket_back.rule: The case's pocket, behind the shaft

pocket_front.rule: The case's pocket, ahead of the shaft

boss.rule: Round the servo's boss, through the stem

cavity.rule: The floor under the horn: what's left of the stem where the horn sweeps

pad_front.rule: The servo's front screw, from the shaft

pad_back.rule: The servo's rear screw, from the shaft

pad_x.rule: A post under each of the servo's tabs, how far past its screw, along the arm

pad_gap.rule: Air between a post and the case's pocket

dip.rule: How far the posts run down into the stem

pilot.rule: An M2 screw self-tapped into a post

reach.rule: The horn's arm, from the axis to its tip, as drawn by the kit's reference horn

slack.rule: The wedge's reach past the horn's tip

spare.rule: The wedge's angular spare each side

rest_a.rule: The horn's arm direction at rest: the tip just touching the finger's flat

close_a.rule: The horn's arm direction at full close: 3 mm of push at the flat
